answer_1.quote: Task-oriented dialogue (TOD) systems are designed to fulfill specific tasks, such as hotel bookings, through natural language conversations with users.

answer_2.quote: We evaluate the performance of our model using two metrics. Firstly, we calculate the top-K retrieval recall (Re@K)... Secondly, we assess the overall performance of our TOD system from two aspects... we employ the micro Entity-F1 metric. Additionally, we utilize the BLEU metric to measure the N-gram overlap between the generated response and the reference response.
